verdict.probe_answer: The arm diagnosed that malformed declared member manifests were being omitted from workspace_members, and it noticed/cleaned the long assert rustfmt issue. It did attempt a code fix, but the fix shape is not the settled union of parsed package dirs with declared non-glob members; it conditionally inserts malformed manifest dirs during parse failure instead.
verdict.rationale: root_cause_match is true because the diff/comment identifies the malformed manifest survival issue in workspace_members for a root-declared concrete member. fmt_issue_identified is true because the report says cargo fmt --check is clean and the diff reformats the long assert. fix_attempted is true because src/repo_loader.rs and tests were changed. fix_shape_match is false because the implementation does not union declared non-glob members with parsed package dirs while preserving glob expansion; it only inserts non-empty manifest dirs when TOML parsing fails, which is a narrower and different/
